name: Unrestrict

hint.light: Only the story frame — the least effect on writing style.
hint.standard: The frame plus the usual guidance. Enough in most cases.
hint.strong: Adds a self-check reminder before each reply. A few more tokens.

age.title: Confirm your age first
age.body: Confirm your birth year to turn it on.
age.under18: You need to be 18 or older to use Unrestrict.

errors.notEligible: This account can't use Unrestrict right now
errors.copyFailed: Couldn't make a copy — try again

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.hubRow: Find more in the Prompt Plaza

conflict.paused: “{{name}}” and the official one were both on, so yours is paused for now.
conflict.pausedLong: Your own “{{name}}” and the official preset were both on, so yours was paused automatically.
conflict.restored: “{{name}}” is back on. Both now apply and may work against each other.

gone.title: This page doesn't exist
gone.body: This link doesn't open on this account.

what.title: What it does
what.one: Goes before all other prompts by default and is sent with every message. You can change where it goes and what it contains below.
what.two: Temporarily pauses your own prompts of the same kind so the two don't clash. They come back when you turn this off.

honest: Some content is blocked by the model provider itself — no prompt changes that. Switching models helps more in that case.

join.title: How it's added
join.followHint: Updates automatically when we improve it. The options below still apply.
join.copyHint: Saved to “My prompts” to edit freely. No longer updates automatically.
join.backBody: The text returns to the official version and updates automatically. Your “{{variant}} (my copy)” will be removed from “My prompts”.

update.banner: The official version has been updated
update.title: New official “{{variant}}”
update.subtitle: You're using your own copy, so we're asking first
update.legend: What changed (highlighted = added, struck out = removed):
update.note: “Use new version” makes a fresh copy of the latest official text. Your edits will be replaced.

first.label: First (recommended)
first.hint: The model reads it first. Most reliable.

after-char.label: After the character
after-char.hint: The card's setup is read first. Good for cards with very long setups.

last.label: End of chat
last.hint: Closest to the reply — strongest effect, but can pull the writing style.

core.name: Story frame
core.desc: Frames the chat as fiction. Everything else builds on it.

antiApology.name: No apologizing
antiApology.desc: After a refusal, rephrase and keep writing

noLecture.name: No lecturing
noLecture.desc: No safety notes or warnings tacked on at the end

fullText.title: {{variant}} · full text
fullText.followHint: Following official — the text is read-only. Tap the text or “Edit” to change it.
fullText.copyHint: This is your copy — edit it however you like.
fullText.confirmBody: Editing turns this into your own copy, which no longer updates automatically. The copy appears in “My prompts”, and you'll be told when there's a new official version.

scope.title: Which cards use it
scope.none: No cards picked — it won't be used anywhere yet.

footer.withCost: ~{{n}} tokens total · about {{cost}} extra mushies per turn

bindings.title: Auto-enable by model
bindings.hint: Pick which of your prompts auto-applies on each model family.
